termsIntro: These Terms govern access to and use of SirRelay, a hosted task coordination service (web application and optional integrations or clients). By creating an account or using the service, you agree to these Terms.
privacyIntro: This Privacy Policy explains how SirRelay collects and uses personal data when you use the hosted service, including optional integrations and clients you connect while signed in.

terms.title: 1. Acceptance
terms.body: If you do not agree to these Terms, do not use SirRelay. If you use the service on behalf of an organisation, you confirm that you have authority to bind that organisation.

terms.title: 2. The service
terms.body: SirRelay helps people and groups coordinate tasks through a web application and optional add-ons (for example messaging delivery or editor or AI clients). How you authenticate those add-ons may include secrets or credentials you create while signed in. Features and available integrations may change as the product evolves. SirRelay is not a general messaging platform, CRM, or guaranteed enterprise SLA.

terms.title: 3. Accounts
terms.body: You must provide accurate account details and keep your password and any access credentials confidential. You are responsible for activity under your account. Operators are responsible for who they invite into a group and for content they create or assign.

terms.title: 4. Acceptable use
terms.body: You may not misuse the service: no unlawful content, no attempts to break security or access other groups’ data, and no abuse of our infrastructure or of third-party services you connect. We may suspend accounts that violate these rules.

terms.title: 5. Integrations
terms.body: Optional integrations (such as messaging platforms or third-party editors) depend on those providers’ availability and on the link you establish with them. We are not responsible for those providers’ outages, policy changes, or account actions on their side.

terms.title: 6. Availability
terms.body: We aim for reliable hosting but do not guarantee uninterrupted access. Keep your own copies of critical information where needed.

terms.title: 7. Liability
terms.body: SirRelay is provided “as is” and “as available”. To the fullest extent permitted by law, we disclaim warranties and are not liable for indirect or consequential damages arising from use of the service. Nothing limits liability that cannot be limited under applicable law.

terms.title: 8. Termination
terms.body: You may stop using the service, leave or delete groups, and permanently delete your account from Profile (Delete account → password confirmation). Deleting your account removes your personal account data; group ownership may transfer to remaining members, and tasks assigned to you are removed. We may suspend or terminate access for breach of these Terms or to protect the service and other users.

terms.title: 9. Changes
terms.body: We may update these Terms. Material changes that affect your rights or how we process personal data will update the version identifier and “Last updated” date, and may ask you to accept again. Routine clarifications or product-description updates that do not change those obligations may be published without a new acceptance prompt. Continued use after a material update you accept, or after you are asked to re-accept, means you agree to the updated Terms.

privacy.title: 1. Who is responsible
privacy.body: SirRelay is operated as a hosted service. The operator of your deployment is the controller of personal data processed for that instance.

privacy.title: 2. Data we collect
privacy.body: Account data (email, name, password hash, locale), group and task data, optional data for integrations you enable (for example messaging link identifiers), credentials or tokens for optional clients you create, session and security logs, and optional self-hosted usage analytics when enabled.

privacy.title: 3. Why we use data
privacy.body: To provide and secure the service, deliver notifications or tasks through integrations you enable, maintain operations, and—if analytics are enabled—understand aggregate product usage. We do not use your data for advertising.

privacy.title: 4. Cookies
privacy.body: We use one essential cookie for your signed-in session. We do not use advertising cookies.

privacy.title: 5. Analytics
privacy.body: When enabled, we run self-hosted analytics on our infrastructure. The tracker is designed to avoid advertising cookies and does not sell your data to third-party ad networks.

privacy.title: 6. Integrations
privacy.body: Connecting a third-party service is optional. That provider’s own privacy policy also applies to data it processes as an independent service.

privacy.title: 7. Retention and security
privacy.body: We keep data while your account and groups remain active. After you delete your account, we remove account data from the live system promptly; copies may remain for a reasonable period in backups, security logs, and legal obligations.

privacy.title: 8. Sharing
privacy.body: We do not sell personal data. We may share data with infrastructure providers needed to host the service, with integration providers when you enable those features, or when required by law.

privacy.title: 9. Your rights
privacy.body: Depending on where you live, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, or export personal data. You can permanently delete your account from Profile (Delete account). For other requests, contact us using the address published in the product.
